visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three individuals—a woman in a white sweater on the left, a man in a black shirt in the center, and a woman in a plaid dress on the right—sit on folding chairs against a backdrop of long, beige vertical pleated curtains. They perform a rhythmic sequence of clapping their hands and then their knees, maintaining a cheerful and focused expression. (2) A transition occurs with a vertical color bar test pattern screen. The group continues their rhythmic clapping game. (3) Various animal emojis, including a cow, duck, cat, snake, horse, and donkey, appear centrally between the participants as they take turns gesturing and pointing at each other. The participants' facial expressions vary from intense concentration to sudden outbursts of laughter and hand-covering embarrassment. (4) The woman in the plaid dress makes dramatic clawing gestures while opening her mouth wide, followed by the man laughing and pointing at her. Additional emojis for insects and mythical creatures like dragons and unicorns appear. (5) The group collapses into laughter, with the woman on the left bending over and covering her face, while the man gestures toward the camera with a puzzled but amused look. They continue the game with smaller gestures and more frequent smiles until the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a fast-paced, rhythmic percussive beat comprised of hand clapping and leg slapping sounds at approximately 105 BPM. A high-pitched female voice shouts the game title over energetic laughter. (2) A synthesized transition sound (electronic glitch) occurs at 0:06. The rhythmic clapping resumes immediately, accompanied by distinct vocalizations where individuals name animals in Mandarin Chinese followed by exaggerated animal sound imitations. (3) Each animal sound is punctuated by a crisp 'ding' or 'pop' sound effect. High-pitched female laughter frequently interrupts the speech as participants fail to maintain the rhythm or make unusual sounds. (4) The male voice exhibits a warm, humorous tone, laughing loudly after a failed attempt. The audio concludes with a final sequence of rapid clapping and a chorus of communal laughter and banter.
